mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales (sold_at, channel_id, note) VALUES (#{soldAt}, #{channelId}, #{note})
INSERT INTO sale_lines (sale_id, variant_id, qty, unit_price, cost_price) VALUES (#{saleId},#{variantId},#{qty},#{unitPrice},#{costPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT price AS unitPrice, cost_price AS costPrice FROM item_variants WHERE id = #{variantId}

SELECT s.id AS id, s.sold_at AS soldAt, s.channel_id AS channelId, ch.name AS channelName, ch.fee_rate AS feeRate, ch.fixed_fee AS fixedFee, s.note AS note,
COUNT(sl.id) AS linesCount, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty), 0) AS totalQty, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.cost_price), 0) AS totalCost,
-- 手数料：売上*(fee_rate/100) (COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) * COALESCE(ch.fee_rate, 0)/100) AS feeAmount,
-- 利益：売上-原価-手数料- 固定費（※固定費は「販売1件」単位で引く） ( COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.cost_price), 0) - (COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0)* COALESCE(ch.fee_rate,0)/100) - COALESCE(ch.fixed_fee,0) ) AS profit
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN sale_lines sl ON sl.sale_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sales_channels ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id GROUP BY s.id, s.sold_at, s.channel_id, ch.name, ch.fee_rate, ch.fixed_fee, s.note ORDER BY s.sold_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, sold_at AS soldAt, channel_id AS channelId, note FROM sales WHERE id = #{saleId}

SELECT sl.id AS id, sl.variant_id AS variantId, v.sku_code AS skuCode, i.name AS itemName, sl.qty AS qty, sl.unit_price AS unitPrice, sl.cost_price AS costPrice, (sl.qty * sl.unit_price) AS lineAmount FROM sale_lines sl JOIN item_variants v ON v.id = sl.variant_id JOIN items i ON i.id = v.item_id WHERE sl.sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY sl.id ASC

SELECT s.channel_id AS channelId, COALESCE(ch.name, '未設定') AS channelName,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS salesCount, COUNT(sl.id) AS linesCount, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty), 0) AS totalQty, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.cost_price), 0) AS totalCost,
-- 手数料合計： 売上合計 * (fee_rate/100) (COALESCE (SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) * COALESCE(ch.fee_rate, 0)/100) AS feeAmount,
-- 固定費合計： 販売件数 * fixed_fee (COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)) * COALESCE(ch.fixed_fee, 0) AS fixed_amount,
-- 利益合計： 売上 - 原価 - 手数料 - 固定費合計 ( COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.cost_price), 0) - ( COALESCE(SUM(sl.qty * sl.unit_price), 0) * COALESCE(ch.fee_rate, 0)/100 ) - ( COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) * COALESCE(ch.fixed_fee, 0) ) ) AS profit
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN sale_lines sl ON sl.sale_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sales_channels ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id
WHERE 1=1
AND s.sold_at>= TIMESTAMP(#{from}, '00:00:00')
AND s.sold_at< TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '00:00:00')
GROUP BY s.channel_id, ch.name, ch.fee_rate, ch.fixed_fee ORDER BY profit DESC
